task: Write the findings summary for the Acme Grid corporate-segment security assessment covering 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-14. State only what the attached evidence establishes.
declared_gaps: The OT/ICS segment was out of scope for this engagement and was not assessed.
Credentialed scanning was unavailable for 6 of the 42 in-scope hosts.

evidence.summary: Authenticated vulnerability scan of 42 in-scope hosts across 10.4.0.0/16 between 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-14. 6 hosts returned unauthenticated results only. No critical-severity finding was open at the close of the window.
evidence.detail: Scanner run scope 10.4.0.0/16; representative host vault-prod-03.internal.acme-grid.example; 42 targets enumerated, 36 credentialed, 6 unauthenticated.

evidence.summary: Manual review of the edge proxy configuration against the reviewed baseline. Two settings were examined: TLS minimum version and the administrative access allowlist.

evidence.summary: Authentication log review for the corporate segment between 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-14. No successful authentication originated outside the allowed source ranges during the window.
